name: sharing without a middleman
headline: Sharing without a *middleman*
sub: Publishing a branch is one command. Visiting is adopting: a click lands the tile in the visitor's own hive, on a named revision line.
visualData: your hive → *signed layers* → their hive — no account in between
say: Reason six: sharing without a middleman. Publishing a branch is one command. Content travels over open relays, and visiting is adopting: click a shared tile and it lands in your own hive, on a named revision line — carry it forward, and still rewind to exactly what was shipped. Collaboration becomes two hives exchanging signed layers. No accounts to reconcile, no permissions matrix. Cryptography instead of bureaucracy.
